title: Usha Khadgi is crowned Miss Nepal.
text: Usha Khadgi is a Nepalese model, television presenter, beauty pageant title holder and business woman. In 2000, she was titled with the seventh Miss Nepal.

title: National Human Rights Commission is established.
text: The National Human Rights Commission of Nepal is an independent and autonomous constitutional body. It was established in the year 2000 as a statutory body under the Human Rights Commission Act 1997 (2053 BS).

title: Nepal Airlines de Havilland Canada DHC-6 Twin Otter crashes in Dadeldhura District killing 25 people.
text: On 27 July 2000, a de Havilland Canada DHC-6 Twin Otter operated by Royal Nepal Airlines crashed in Nepal en route from Bajhang Airport to Dhangadhi Airport on a domestic passenger flight. The wreckage of the aircraft, registration 9N-ABP, was found in Jogbuda, Dadeldhura District.
